paite: Mosi in asungpa, Midian siampu, Jethro belamhonte aching hi. Gamdai nunglam a belamhonte pi in, Pathian tang, Horeb pha in, ahong pai hi.
heading: Pathian In Mosi Asam
english: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.

paite: Pawn lak a pan meikuang in akiang ah TOUPA Angel ahong kilak hí. A-en a, ngai in, mei in loubukh akuang a, himahleh loubukh akang kei hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

paite: Mosi in, “Ka kihei dia, hiai thil muh thupi, bangziak a loubukh kang lou ahia, ka va en ding,” achi hi.
english: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”

paite: Huchi a-en dia kihei lai TOUPA'N amuh in loubuk a pan amah asam a, "Mosi, Mosi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: When Yahweh saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hiai mun hon naih ke'n. Na khepek a pan na khedapte suah in. Na dinna mun lei siangthou ahi,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”

paite: Hiai achi lai a, "Na pa' Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ka hi," Mosi in Pathian a-et ngam louh ziak in amai asel hi.
english: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Aigupta gam a ka mite thuakgimna ka mu a, atung ua nasem heutute ziak a akah uh ka zata a, adahnate uh ka thei hi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.

paite: "Aiguptate khut a pan amaute pikhe ding leh huai gam a pan gam hoih leh za, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam, Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam tun dia hong paisuk ka hi.
english: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ngai in, Israel suante kah thawm ka kiang ahong tungta. Aiguptate'n amau anuaisiahdan uh leng ka mu hi.
english: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kisa in, Pharaoh kiang ah ka hon sawl ding, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante, ka mite na hon pikhiak theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”

paite: Mosi in Pathian kiang ah, "Pharoah kiang a hoh a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante pikhe ding, kei kua ka hia?" achi hi.
english: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”

paite: Ama'n, "Na kiang ah ka om ngeingei ding, ka hon sawl chih, hiai nang a ding in akitheihna ahi ding. Aigupta gam a pan mite na pikhiak khit chiang in, hiai tang tung ah Pathian nna na sem ding uh," achi hi.
english: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”

paite: Mosi in Pathian kiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel suante kiang a ka hong pai a, akiang ua, hichibang a ka va gen chiang in, 'Na pipute uh Pathian in na kiang ua ahon sawl ka hi,' huan amau ka kiang ah, 'Amin bang ahia?' chi in ahon dong ding ua, ke'n akiang uah bang ka genta dia?" achi hi.
english: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”

paite: Pathian in Mosi kiang ah, "KA HIH KA HI,” achi hi. Huchibang in Israel suante kiang ah na va gen ding ahi, “KA HIH IN na kiang uah ahon sawl hi," chi in.
english: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”

paite: Pathian in Mosi kiang ah agen behlap lai a, “Israel suante kiang ah hiai gen in: Israel suante Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian in na kiang uah ahon sawl hi: "Hiai ka min ahi gige a, suan tengteng tan a kei theihgigena min ahi.
english: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.

paite: Kuan inla, Israel upate kaikhawm inla, akiang uah hichi in va gen in. Ka kiang ah, 'Na pipute uh TOUPA Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ahong kilak a, hichi in achi, "Ka hong veh petmah a, Aigupta gam a na tung ua hih a omte ka muta hi."
english: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi in ka chita, Aigupta gimna a pan Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ah ka hon pilut ding."
english: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’

paite: "Na aw angaikhe ding uhi. Huchi in na kuan ding a, nang leh Israel upate, Aigupta kumpipa kiang ah na va hoh ding ua, akiang ah hichibang in na va gen ding uhi. Hebrute' TOUPA Pathian in ahon kimuhpih a, tu in, ka hon ngen uhi, hon paisak in, gamdai a ni thum lam a TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a ka kithoihtheihna ding un.
english: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh, our God.’

paite: Ahi a, Aigupta kumpipa'n bantha hatna toh lou in ahon paisak kei ding chih ka theitel hi.
english: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.

paite: Ka ban ka zak ding a, alak ua ka hih ding ka thillamdang tengteng in Aigupta gam ka gawt ding. Huai nung in ahon paisak pan ding hi.
english: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.

paite: "Aiguptate mitmuh in hiai mite deihsakna ka pe ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, na pai chiang un khutvuak in na pai kei ding uh.
english: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.

paite: Numei teng in invengte leh a-inn a khualtamte a pan dangka suangmantamte, dangka-eng suangmantamte leh puansilhte aleitawi ding. Huchi in huaite na tapate uh na silhsak ding ua, na tanute uh na silhsak ding uh. Huchibang in Aiguptate na lok ding uhi," achi hi.
english: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”
